scenes.say: Thanksgiving sides can quietly add up to a lot of carbs. Try these four swaps.
scenes.headline: 4 THANKSGIVING SIDE SWAPS

scenes.say: Swap one. Trade some mashed potatoes for cauliflower mash.
scenes.headline: SWAP 1

scenes.say: A cup of mashed potatoes has about thirty five grams of carbs. Cauliflower mash, about nine.
scenes.headline: CARBS PER CUP

scenes.say: Love potatoes? Go half and half.
scenes.headline: OR GO HALF AND HALF

scenes.say: Swap two. Skip the marshmallows. Roast sweet potatoes, or top with a few nuts.
scenes.headline: SWAP 2

scenes.say: Three and four. Roasted green beans over the creamy casserole, and a whole grain roll over white.
scenes.headline: SWAPS 3 AND 4

scenes.say: Sweet potatoes and rolls still have carbs, so keep portions small.
scenes.headline: PORTIONS STILL MATTER

scenes.say: Which side can't you give up? Comment below, and follow for more holiday tips.
scenes.headline: WHICH SIDE CAN'T YOU GIVE UP?
